title: Logspace uniformity of the example family
statement: The example circuit family is logspace-uniform: there is a function mapping binary strings to binary strings whose output length is bounded by a polynomial in the input length, whose bit values and output-length predicate are each decidable in logarithmic space when given an input string and an index, and which, on the unary string of $n$ ones, outputs the encoding of the circuit for length $n$.
